chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْه، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ حَمَّادٍ النَّابِ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Safwan, from Hammad al-Nab who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَفْعُورَ يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلَامَ، قَالَ: وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.en: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Abdallah ibn Abi Ya'fur sends you greetings of peace, he said: and upon him be peace.

en.summary: This brief narration from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights the intimate spiritual bond between Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and his trusted secretary, Abdallah ibn Abi Ya'fur, whose greetings were received with the specific honorific 'wa 'alayhi al-salam' (and upon him be peace), indicating a high degree of closeness. It underscores the Imam's personal engagement with his companions, reinforcing Abdallah's status as a key figure in the transmission of hadith and administrative affairs during the Imamate.
en.seo_question: What was the response of Imam al-Sadiq to the greetings from Abdallah ibn Abi Ya'fur?
